step1_analysis.circuit_type: Decision-Feedback Equalizer (DFE) Tap / Current Steering Branch
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a differential pair with diode-connected PMOS loads, where the inputs are hardwired to VDD and VSS. It acts as a fixed-weight tap or dummy branch in a DFE, steering a constant tail current to one of the output summing nodes (VB) while leaving the other (N1) pulled to VDD.

paper_reference.title: Analog Timing Recovery for a Noise-Predictive Decision-Feedback Equalizer

power_dc.description: DC power consumption of the tap branch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 100uA tail current is applied to N0: P = VDD * I_tail = 1.8V * 100uA = 180 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 27 mW reported in the paper is for the entire timing recovery block. A single DFE tap in 1.8V SKY130 will consume a fraction of this, dominated by its tail current.

v_swing.description: Output voltage swing at the active summing node (VB) when the tail current is switched.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing = I_tail / gm_pmos. gm_pmos = sqrt(2 * upCox * (W/L) * I_tail) = sqrt(2 * 50uA/V^2 * (10u/0.5u) * 100uA) = 0.447 mS. Swing = 100uA / 0.447mS = 223 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the square-law model for the diode-connected PMOS loads (XM3/XM4 in parallel).

t_fall.description: Fall time of the output node when the tap is enabled.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_fall ~ 2.2 * R * C. R = 1/gm_pmos = 2.23 kOhm. C ~ Cgs_pmos + Cdb_nmos ~ 20 fF. t_fall = 2.2 * 2.23k * 20fF = 98 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant of the diode-connected load and local parasitic capacitances.

transimpedance_gain.description: Low-frequency transimpedance gain from tail current to output voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = 1/gm_pmos = 2.23 kOhm. For a 1uA AC input, Vout = 2.23 mV. Gain in dBV = 20*log10(2.23e-3) = -53 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the small-signal resistance of the diode-connected PMOS loads. The 2 dB reported in the paper likely refers to the overall equalizer gain, not this specific node.

capacitance_load.description: Parasitic capacitance at the output node.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 40 pF reported in the paper is likely a large loop filter capacitor. This sub-block only has intrinsic device parasitics.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, transimpedance gain, and transient switching characteristics of the DFE tap by modulating its tail current.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DFE Tap Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM3 VB VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VB VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 N1 VSS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VB VDD N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VGND GND 0 0

* Tail current source at N0 (simulating tap enable/disable)
* DC 100uA, AC 1uA for small signal, PULSE for transient switching
I_tail N0 GND DC 100u AC 1u PULSE(0 100u 1n 10p 10p 1n 2n)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(VB) v(N1) v(N0)

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 10 1Meg 10Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(VB)
  meas ac gain_1M find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac gain_1G find gain_db at=1Gig

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 3n
  meas tran v_max max v(VB)
  meas tran v_min min v(VB)
  
  * Measure fall and rise times (1.75V to 1.65V thresholds based on expected swing)
  meas tran t_fall trig v(VB) val=1.75 fall=1 targ v(VB) val=1.65 fall=1
  meas tran t_rise trig v(VB) val=1.65 rise=1 targ v(VB) val=1.75 rise=1

  quit
.endc
